facts.fact: Cameroon's Ministry of Public Contracts said an Electronic Certificate, used mainly to authenticate the identity of individuals or legal persons using the COLEPS e-procurement platform, is acquired by users, who were being trained on it from 10 October 2024.

Minister Ibrahim Talba Malla said Cameroon's online e-procurement system COLEPS, piloted from 2019, is in use, with a nationwide stakeholder training campaign launched on 10 October 2024 and awards given to ministries for using it.

CMR.note: Award targets (80%, 90%) and the 11 to 24 ministries extension are commitments, not reported use; no end-to-end or required-of-all statement.
